summary: Iter50 theme-overhaul regression. (1) Backend: tests/test_iter48_retest.py = 6/6 PASS (no regression). (2) Test-id preservation: ALL 40+ requested data-testids render exactly once on their pages (landing, pricing incl. sailor-months-1 + stripe-test-hint after audience switch, contact, community-hub, /@captainjane incl. handle-dm when signed in as seed_marina, handle-notfound for /@zzz_no_such, directory with 4 pro-card-<id>). Zero missing, zero duplicates. (3) Header: /(landing) opens data-transparent=true, flips to false after 200px scroll (backdrop-blur-xl solid surface) and back to true at top; /pricing, /contact, /directory, /community-hub, /@captainjane, /dashboard all data-transparent=false on load. theme-toggle present on every page; click toggles html.dark and persists localStorage['smn-theme'] across reload; aria-label/icon flip correctly (Moon in light, Sun in dark). (4) Wave dividers: 3 on landing, 1 each on the other 5 public routes; inline SVG viewBox 0 0 1440 120 + preserveAspectRatio=none, no baseline gap. (5) Dark/light x laptop(1440)/tablet(900)/mobile(420) across all 6 public routes: zero console pageerrors, theme class applied correctly in all 36 combos, hero band stays dark, amber CTAs visible. Found 3 real defects: an invisible dark-mode heading on landing, a header layout overflow at 768-1000px, and directory pro-card overflow on mobile, plus low-contrast micro-labels.

ui_bugs.issue: DARK MODE: H2 'Sailors ready to hop on a boat.' and the 'See all races' link are hardcoded text-[#1F3F5B] with no dark: variant -> rendered navy on slate-800 band (contrast 1.34:1, effectively invisible). Reproduced at all 3 viewports in dark theme. Also the crew-slot card inside this section stays pure white in dark mode, unlike the dark:bg-slate-800 cards elsewhere.

TABLET LAYOUT OVERFLOW: at 768-1000px the md: desktop nav + market selector + theme toggle + Sign in add up to ~978px, so document.scrollWidth > viewport on every route and [data-testid=login-btn] renders at x=904 (off-screen at vw=768/900). User must horizontally scroll to reach Sign in / theme toggle. Suggest raising the desktop-nav breakpoint to lg: or hiding the market selector below lg.

MOBILE OVERFLOW: pro-card measures 480px inside a 388px single-column grid at vw=420 (both themes) -> page scrolls horizontally, the PREMIUM/FEATURED badge (absolute top-4 right-4) and the markets text are clipped outside the screen. Grid child needs min-w-0 (and the avatar/title flex row + rating row need min-w-0/flex-wrap) so min-content doesn't blow out the column.
Decorative watermark img (hidden lg:block absolute -right-24 -top-8 w-[520px] opacity-10) extends to x=1536 at vw=1440 causing a horizontal scrollbar on /. Add overflow-hidden to the hero band.
With auth links (Reviews/Digest) + admin/market/search/bell/messages/profile the nav wraps to two lines ('Boat Pros', 'Crew Bank' break) at 1440px. Cosmetic crowding.

design_issues.screen: All public pages - SectionEyebrow / tier labels (light theme)
issues: Teal #55B3AD 11-12px uppercase eyebrows on white/off-white surfaces measure 2.37-2.49:1 (need 4.5:1): 'Marine service directory', 'Pricing', 'Say hello', 'Sailor profile', 'About', 'Recent posts', tier labels 'Basic'/'Featured'. Darken the eyebrow token (e.g. #2F7D78) or bump weight/size.
Amber #F2A03B eyebrow on off-white (community-hub) = 2.03:1; amber 'Open ->' link on white card = 2.13:1.
White text on #F2A03B (PREMIUM badge, info@sailmorenow.com pill, 'Browse the directory' CTA) = 2.13:1; white on #55B3AD (FEATURED badge) = 2.49:1. Use navy text on amber/teal fills instead of white.
Teal column headings on navy = 4.39:1 and slate-400 body/copyright on navy = 4.26:1 - just under 4.5:1.
~130px of empty space between the wave divider and the first content row (search bar) on /directory at laptop and mobile - band padding looks unintentional/oversized.

action_items: OpenCrewSlots.jsx: add dark: variants to the H2 and 'See all races' link (dark:text-white / dark:text-slate-200) and give the crew-slot card dark:bg-slate-800 + dark border.
Header.jsx: fix 768-1000px overflow - move desktop nav to lg:flex or hide market selector below lg so Sign in + theme toggle stay on screen.
Directory ProCard: add min-w-0 (grid child + inner flex rows) to stop 480px min-content overflow at 420px.
Add overflow-hidden to the landing hero band so the decorative watermark doesn't create horizontal scroll.
Contrast pass on teal/amber micro-labels and badges (2.0-2.5:1) and footer link/copy colours (4.26-4.39:1).
critical_code_review_comments: Hardcoded brand hexes (text-[#1F3F5B]) without paired dark: variants are the systemic risk of this theme pass - OpenCrewSlots.jsx and CommunityHub.jsx:110 both do it. Consider a semantic token (e.g. text-ink / .smn-heading) applied once in index.css instead of per-element hex.

Header renders a second <ThemeToggle> inside the mobile drawer, so [data-testid=theme-toggle] resolves to 2 nodes whenever the drawer is open - give the drawer instance a distinct testid (theme-toggle-mobile) to keep future strict-mode selectors safe.

ThemeContext writes localStorage only via setTheme/toggle (correct), but initialTheme runs before paint in React state - a small inline script in index.html would remove the light-flash on first dark-mode load.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) OpenCrewSlots.jsx keeps light-only brand hex classes (text-[#1F3F5B]) while its parent band picked up dark:bg-slate-800 in the theme pass -> navy-on-navy. 2) Header keeps the md: breakpoint for the full 8-item desktop nav plus market selector; the combined intrinsic width (~978px) exceeds 768-960px viewports, pushing the auth cluster past the right edge. 3) Directory grid items lack min-w-0, so the card's min-content width (avatar + non-shrinking title/rating rows) forces 480px inside a 388px column.
